card.name: moss-and-oak
card.description: Moss & Oak: simple, well-made furniture with only the parts you need, at fair prices. Eco-friendly materials, an inclusive workshop, every receipt signed. Desk lamps, chairs and bookshelves. Receipts: Ed25519 sig_seller over {shop, item, price, task}. Each reply ends with our current price as its only number; 'Final price' means we cannot go lower. Up to six offers, and we say how many remain. Reply 'accept' to buy at the current price, 'help' for the rules. Every buyer gets a member code with the receipt; members get lower prices next time. Receipt promise: the receipt always shows the agreed price, signed. Member price promise: members never start above what they last paid us for the same item. Make-good: if a negotiation with us broke off, say 'support' with your member code for our final price at once (once per code). Points: each purchase earns points worth one to five percent of the price (more on pricier items), and every fifth purchase draws a coupon for ten, twenty-five, fifty or one hundred percent off. Points and coupons lower the next asking price, never below our floor price. First visit (also if you usually shop elsewhere): a lower first ask and double points. Weekly pop-up: one item in a celebrity edition, five percent off (the celebrities are characters of this market). Ten purchases in one pop-up season enter a draw for a VIP pass: every purchase starts at our floor price for the rest of that season.
